svg.title: IncludeFixer and orchestration stay in the core
svg.desc: IncludeFixer stays in ParsedAST; colors show reindentation and rewrites within the same core file. Clang's typo-correction adjustment, include fixes, token collection and lifecycle dispatch remain in the core. Preamble.cpp and FeatureModule.h are unchanged; the existing lifecycle hooks are reused. IncludeFixer and typo-correction severity handling remain in the core. Frontend execution, token collection, traversal restriction and lifecycle dispatch remain in place.
svg.text: IncludeFixer and orchestration stay in the core
IncludeFixer stays in ParsedAST; colors show reindentation and rewrites within the same core file. Clang's typo-correction adjustment, include
fixes, token collection and lifecycle dispatch remain in the core. Preamble.cpp and FeatureModule.h are unchanged; the existing lifecycle
// AST traversals should exclude the preamble, to avoid performance cliffs.
// Run the AST-dependent part of the clang-tidy checks.
// (The preprocessor part ran already, via PPCallbacks).
// Clang only corrects typos for use of undeclared functions in C if that
// use is an error. Include fixer relies on typo correction, so pretend
// this is an error. (The actual typo correction is nice too).
// We restore the original severity in the level adjuster.
// FIXME: It would be better to have a real API for this, but what?
// FIXME: Consider piping through ASTSignals to fetch this to handle the
// case where a header file contains ObjC decls but no #imports.
// AST traversals should exclude the preamble, to avoid performance cliffs.
IncludeFixer and typo-correction severity handling remain in the core.
Frontend execution, token collection, traversal restriction and lifecycle dispatch remain in place.
